narrative:

The high amount you asked for was the single biggest reason for the denial. At 10,623 DM, your request is more than three times the average amount approved applicants ask for, and this large sum pushed the decision strongly toward viewing you as higher risk. Your checking account status of less than 0 DM was the second most important factor and also increased the predicted risk, as only 12.6% of approved applicants are in this negative-balance category. In contrast, your credit history labeled as critical or other existing credits actually worked in your favor and pulled the prediction somewhat toward approval. This history is fairly common among approved customers, yet it was not enough to overcome the negative impact of the large loan size and negative account status.

To improve your chances next time, consider applying for a substantially smaller loan amount, wait until your checking account balance is positive, and continue to manage your existing credit responsibly. These steps would directly address the main reasons the model turned down this application. (218 words)
